note: HS mismatch: declared 392330 (carboys/bottles/flasks of plastics) vs actual shipment HS 39206919 (other plates/sheets/film of plastics - multi-layer extruded plastic packing material, tube laminate). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, code corrected to 39206919, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label 'Строительство и DIY' is wrong - actual business is primary flexible packaging (multilayer laminated tubes, tube laminates, flexible laminates) for oral care, pharma, cosmetics and FMCG; Nirma group subsidiary, listed on BSE/NSE. Role: manufacturer (own plant in Gandhinagar, Gujarat), not a trader. Both export and domestic supply are factually confirmed by dated records, not by website statements. Revenue: FY2025 approx Rs 208 crore, FY2026 approx Rs 240 crore (Screener, standalone). Export volume in absolute terms is not public on the free view - null, not estimated. Search tool (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down during this check, so volza/eximpedia/importgenius/trademo cross-checks and GeM/CPPP tender lookups could not be run; ImportKey was the only shipment source read.
